description:
Water resistant fleece pants solve a problem every Kenyan hiker knows: cold, damp legs on a mountain morning. On Mt Kenya, the Aberdares and Kinangop, mist, dew and drizzle soak through ordinary trousers in minutes, and wet fabric pulls heat from your body fast. Jeans and tracksuits are the worst offenders, staying heavy and cold for hours.

These water resistant fleece pants pair a fleece lining for warmth with an outer that sheds light rain, mist and wet grass. You stay warm at a chilly 5am start, dry through damp moorland, and comfortable when the wind picks up near the summit. They give you real warmth without the bulk of layering two pairs of trousers.

Why Choose Water Resistant Fleece Pants?

Warmth alone is not enough on Kenya's high trails. A fleece-lined pant that soaks up water loses much of its insulation, and you end up cold anyway. Water resistant fleece pants keep the fleece working by stopping light moisture at the surface, so the warm layer next to your skin stays dry for longer.

They sit between our other cold-weather options. For mostly dry, windy days, the Fleece Lined Summit Pants are a strong pick. For steady, heavy rain, add our waterproof rain pants over the top. For warmth under any trouser, see the fleece lined thermal pants.

Key Features

  • Soft fleece lining that traps body heat on cold mornings and summits
  • Water resistant outer that sheds light rain, mist, dew and wet grass
  • Warm in one layer, without wearing two pairs of trousers
  • Built for hiking, camping and cold-weather travel
  • Suits high-altitude treks, camping nights and early safari drives
  • Quality outdoor gear at a fair Nairobi price

Benefits of Water Resistant Fleece Pants

Here is what water resistant fleece pants do for you on a cold, damp trail.

  • Warm legs, all day: The fleece lining holds heat from the first step at dawn to the last stretch back to camp.
  • Drier in mist and drizzle: Light rain and wet vegetation bead on the surface instead of soaking straight in.
  • Fewer layers to carry: One pair does the work of a base layer and a trouser on most cold hikes.
  • Comfort at camp: Pull them on after the hike for warm evenings around the fire and cold nights in the tent.
  • Versatile wear: Use them for hiking, camping, early game drives and cold Nairobi mornings.

Perfect For

  • Mt Kenya treks, including the cold summit push to Point Lenana
  • Aberdares and Kinangop hikes, where mist and drizzle are common
  • Camping trips with cold nights and dewy mornings
  • Early-morning game drives in open safari vehicles
  • Hikers who feel the cold and want warmth without bulk

Where to Wear Water Resistant Fleece Pants in Kenya

The higher you go, the more you will want them. On Mt Kenya, nights at Shipton's, Mintos and Austrian Hut drop below freezing, and the moorland is often wet with mist. The Aberdares, Elephant Hill, Satima and the Kinangop plateau bring cold winds and sudden drizzle. Mt Elgon, the Cherangani Hills and the Mau Forest can be just as damp and chilly.

Closer to Nairobi, they suit early starts on Mt Longonot and Ngong Hills during the cold months of June to August, and camping at Naivasha, Kereita Forest or Lake Elementaita, where mornings are cool and the grass is wet with dew.

Layering is the key to staying warm on a mountain. The REI guide to layering basics explains how base, mid and outer layers work together, and the same rules apply to your legs. Pair your pants with merino wool hiking socks for warm, dry feet from top to toe.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are water resistant fleece pants waterproof?

No. Water resistant fleece pants shed light rain, mist and wet grass, but in steady, heavy rain water will eventually get through. For long downpours, wear waterproof rain pants over them.

Are they warm enough for Mt Kenya?

They are a good choice for cold trekking days and evenings at camp. For the summit night, wear a thermal base layer underneath for extra warmth.

Can I wear them on a normal day hike?

Yes, on cool or misty days. On hot, sunny trails at lower altitude, quick dry pants will be more comfortable.
